description: Put a site nobody owns yet on a domain your human already has; once someone owns the site, its domain is set only from its settings. Returns the DNS records they must set where they bought it: first a TXT record proving the domain is theirs, then the records that point it here. The site moves to the domain once those records are seen; call domain_status to check.

token.description: The site token from create_site or the site's settings. Omit if your Authorization header carries it.

name: set_domain
title: Use a domain
